Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Dev Gov Day 2026

request.what: Treasury withdrawal to make Cardano the title sponsor of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream and to support Rare Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, described as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to cover two Cardano sponsorship packages and related fees, taxes, audit, and a 2027 venue deposit.

The proposed cost breakdown allocates ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship for mainstage and livestream with media sponsorship, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network states it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current retail value of a VIP ticket stated as $900.

Rare Evo 2026 is stated to occur regardless of treasury funding, but the proposal says funding would substantially expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and strategic industry outreach.
Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The document reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 annual attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social media impressions, and 40+ Cardano projects represented.

The document states that Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included a keynote from Charles Hoskinson, governance discussions, technical education, workshops, and community-building activities.

The proposal says selected Cardano projects and individuals will use open application processes for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer roles, and travel or lodging assistance, with selection prioritizing ecosystem contribution and in-person value creation.

The proposal claims alignment with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability pillars by expanding governance programming, free participation, workshops, media distribution, and ecosystem contributor attendance.
The document provides external links to supporting materials including Rare Evo 2025 videos, a Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 report, recap, and livestream.

summary: The proposal requests ₳2.75 million for Cardano sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 and Rare Dev Gov Day 2026, citing prior event metrics, ecosystem-growth benefits, free access and booth benefits, contributor travel support, media and livestream exposure, and a 20% VIP ticket sales return to the treasury.
